summary: Round r1 (restricted network; data hosts blocked; the agent's single WebSearch was spent on 27D). 69 source leads recorded, reused from the shared lead register and upstream findings 04A, 04B, 04C, 17A-17E, 26D, plus 18A/18D/23B/25B leads and three URLs marked 'URL from general knowledge - unverified' (UN Treaty Series, MoFA treaty list, MCC Nepal Compact page). Q1 (which bilateral agreements are in force, with verified text and dates) is set up as a 29-row de-duplicated verified_agreement_register: 15 India rows (trade, transit, rail, unauthorised trade, power 2014, long-term power 2024, transmission 2025, petroleum, fertiliser, Mahakali, Kosi, Gandak, BIPPA, including two unilateral Indian instruments that are flagged and excluded from agreement counts), five other BITs (26D), DTAAs, four China rows (BRI framework, transit protocol, border ports, unilateral LDC zero-tariff), US TIFA and MCC Compact, bilateral labour MoUs and a cross-reference to the 17C trilateral power arrangement. Regional instruments stay with 17D. Every status and date is pending: status can only be set from a retrieved primary text. Two documented conflicts are carried forward without resolution (India-Nepal BIPPA in force vs revoked; long-term power agreement ratification route). No numbers recorded. Nothing here represents any government's position.

findings.claim: Q1: Which bilateral agreements between Nepal and its partners are in force, with verified text, signature, entry-into-force and last-revision dates - 29-row consolidated register in specific.verified_agreement_register (India 15 rows incl. 2 unilateral Indian instruments; other BITs 5; DTAAs 1; China 4 incl. 1 unilateral measure; US 2; labour MoUs 1; trilateral cross-reference 1).
findings.note: No primary text retrieved in r1 (data hosts blocked). Required: authenticated texts and entry-into-force records per row; see data_required per row.

findings.claim: Q1a: Count of bilateral agreements verified as in force (OPERATIONAL or IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE).
findings.note: Computed only from rows with a retrieved primary text; unilateral instruments (AR-08, AR-11, AR-24) and cross-references (AR-29) excluded.

findings.claim: Q1b: India-Nepal BIPPA (AR-15) status is contested across leads (in force with automatic renewal vs revoked by India).
findings.note: Keep both readings (26D conflict) until a dated termination notice or official status record is retrieved; escalate to 00B if the retrieved records disagree.

findings.claim: Q1c: Long-term power trade agreement (AR-06) - status cannot be set: no text located, and the Nepal-side ratification route was litigated per a news locator.
findings.note: Needs agreement text and the Supreme Court verdict text; JSC minutes and NEA export records as implementing evidence.

findings.claim: Method: a register row's status is set only from a retrieved primary text; joint statements yield at most AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED; news and academic sources locate documents only.

Method: unilateral instruments that condition a bilateral relation (Indian cross-border electricity rules, RBI exchange-control rules, China LDC zero-tariff) are recorded but never counted as bilateral agreements.
Method: dates are recorded in the calendar given by the text (Gregorian or Bikram Sambat) with both shown when the text gives both; no conversion is inferred.

This register records documented instruments; it does not state or represent the position or intentions of the Government of Nepal or any other government. Any arrangement modelled downstream (27B, 27E) is hypothetical.

Texts of transmission-line implementing agreements (October 2025) and G2G fertiliser arrangement.

assumptions.text: Status classes follow 17B-A1, extended with TERMINATED; set only from primary text plus implementing record.

Where the same instrument appears in several upstream inventories under different names, the most specific name from the text will replace the working name in r2; consolidated_from preserves the upstream references.
Rail services agreement is kept as a separate row from the Treaty of Transit (04C merges them) to preserve amendment chronology; both rows cross-reference each other.

Instruments outside the upstream inventories (US TIFA, MCC Compact, labour MoUs, DTAAs, non-India BITs) are included because they are bilateral economic commitments; their owners (18A, 18D, 23B, 26D) remain primary.

challenges.text: The responsibility matrix omits the October 2025 transmission implementing agreements, the G2G fertiliser arrangement, non-India BITs, DTAAs, US TIFA/MCC Compact and bilateral labour MoUs; register rows AR-07, AR-10, AR-16..AR-21, AR-26..AR-28 have no owner mapping - please add or state why excluded.

agreement_inventory lists the rail services agreement as a separate row while 04C merges it into transit; 27A keeps it separate (AR-03). Please align naming and add the water treaties and BIPPA (as already requested by 04C).
The BIPPA conflict (in force vs revoked) bears directly on 27C investment-structure options and on 27E feasibility; please prioritise retrieval of the dated termination instrument in r2.
Add catalog ids for UN Treaty Series, MCC, DoFE labour agreements and IRD (DTAAs); several 27A leads use null or nearest ids.

uncertainty: Very high for r1: no primary text retrieved, so no row has a verified status or date. Upstream inventories name instruments partly from general domain knowledge; some rows may merge or split once texts are read (e.g. transit protocol vs letters of exchange; labour MoUs). Two rows carry unresolved source conflicts (AR-06, AR-15). Coverage beyond India/China (DTAAs, labour MoUs) depends on lists not yet located.

verified_agreement_register.question: Q1 Which bilateral agreements are in force, with verified text and dates?
verified_agreement_register.method: One row per instrument, de-duplicated across 04A agreement_inventory, 04C responsibility_matrix, 17A policy_watchlist, 17B connectivity_status, 17C, 17D (bilateral rows only), 17E river_treaty_inventory, 04B project_status_register and 26D bit_inventory. Status classes follow 17B-A1 (OPERATIONAL, IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE, AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED, PROPOSED, LAPSED_OR_STALLED) plus TERMINATED. A status is set only from a retrieved primary text (Nepal official host preferred; MEA/Indian official host, UNTS or depositary as second copy) and, for OPERATIONAL, an implementing record. News, academic and database records are locators or conflict checks only. Unilateral instruments are listed but flagged and excluded from counts of bilateral agreements. Where copies differ, both are kept and the difference recorded.

counterparty official host (MEA, PIB, MOFCOM/State Council, USTR/MCC)
secondary reproductions (FAOLEX, ILM/PCA, CommonLII, ESCAP, TDM)
database records (UNCTAD IIA, ADB ARIC) - conflict check only
